statement: The assumption that large-model accuracy is invariant to routing may not hold in other domains, which would confound the expected benefits of calibration-based threshold policies.

evidence.quote: Assumption (ii) of Theorem 1 (large-model accuracy invari- ant to routing) is the most restrictive. If escalated queries are systematically harder,αℓ on the escalated subset can fall below the marginalαℓ.
